subject: Appointment confirmation and unexpected cost
text: We can keep the appointment on Thursday at 10:30, but I need to tell you about an unanticipated expense that may affect our budget. During our last review, our operations director found that shipping fees rose because we changed our warehouse location at short notice. The increase is small, but it creates a gap we did not expect, so we must be careful before approving any extra work. Please let me know whether the quoted amount for the service includes all required parts, travel, and reporting. If anything has already been scheduled for delivery, do not add more items unless I confirm in writing. We are still committed to completing the project, but we may need to split the payment over two months. If that is difficult, send me your standard terms so I can ask finance for approval quickly. I appreciate your flexibility, and I hope we can handle this without delaying the appointment. Please note the revised estimate in your system before Thursday morning so nobody repeats the same mistake. Thanks, Team Lead
